title: PoseVLN: Learning Geometric State Evolution for Vision-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to relate past experience, current spatial state, and future motion while following natural-language instructions. Recent approaches improve these capabilities through long-horizon memory, state-aware reasoning, and future prediction, yet these components are often modeled separately, leaving navigation state evolution insufficiently connected across time. We argue that camera pose provides a natural geometric representation for bridging past, present, and future states. Based on this insight, we propose PoseVLN, a pose-aware VLN framework that jointly learns navigation decisions and geometric state evolution. PoseVLN organizes visual memory and the current observation in an episode-relative coordinate frame, and jointly predicts the next K navigation actions together with a local $\Delta$Pose over the same horizon. translated_title: PoseVLN：面向视觉-语言导航的几何状态演化学习
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体在遵循自然语言指令的同时，将过去经验、当前空间状态和未来运动关联起来。近期方法通过长时程记忆、状态感知推理和未来预测来提升这些能力，但这些组件往往被分开建模，导致导航状态在时间维度上的演化缺乏充分关联。我们认为，相机位姿为连接过去、现在与未来状态提供了一种自然的几何表示。基于这一见解，我们提出了PoseVLN，一个位姿感知的VLN框架，它联合学习导航决策与几何状态演化。PoseVLN在以回合为参照的相对坐标系中组织视觉记忆和当前观测，并在同一时间范围内联合预测接下来的K个导航动作以及局部位姿增量（ΔPose）。预测的ΔPose与当前轨迹进行复合（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: PoseVLN以相机位姿作为连接过去、现在与未来状态的几何桥梁，在回合相对坐标系中联合预测未来K个导航动作和位姿增量，从而实现导航决策与几何状态演化的统一学习。
en_tdlr: PoseVLN uses camera pose as a natural geometric bridge across past, present, and future states, jointly predicting the next K actions and local ΔPose in an episode-relative frame to unify navigation decisions with geometric state evolution.
